title: The Old guy in The Cabin
content: met an old guy, had a conversation about me lucid dreaming. while lucid someone tried to come in cabin and attack, I shot them. (Remained lucid the entire time) The old man went on to helping me…and told me to read something. I’ve never read anything in my dreams, so I picked up a piece of paper on a desk. It took a second to focus and really hone in, but I actually formulated words on a paper. Only words I remember were “WW111” and “Love”.
